full_prompt_en: A square, richly staged photographic close-up shows a flower-crowned young figure amid dense blossoms and jewel-colored light. The background is a dark tangle of leaves and flowers, broken by small warm points of illumination that glow between stems. The figure's face fills the left and central part of the frame in three-quarter view, inclined downward toward a cluster of pink flowers at the lower right. Closed eyelids and softly parted lips give the expression a quiet, absorbed quality. A lush headdress covers the hairline and upper forehead with pale blossoms, teal-green beads, reflective sequins, and tiny purple accents. Loose flowers and curled foliage continue around the left ear and across the top edge, merging the figure with the surrounding garden. A hand rests beside the flowers at the right, its curved fingers close to the large rose-colored bloom. The shoulders and upper chest at lower left carry more layered fabric and glinting adornment, with pink, gold, and blue reflections catching on small surfaces. Cool cyan light falls across the forehead, nose, and cheek, while warm amber and coral light rises from the left and behind. This opposed lighting divides the face into vivid colored planes without flattening its natural contours. The petals in the near foreground are soft and full, some overlapping the hand and shoulder; tiny sparkles appear among the darker leaves. The close crop leaves no visible horizon or setting beyond the floral enclosure. The image has shallow focus and a glossy, tactile finish, with sharp facial features and selected sequins set against softened foliage. The overall composition is lush and intimate, using cool face light against warm blooms and dark negative pockets to create a dreamlike theatrical mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、精心布置的摄影特写呈现一名戴花冠的年轻人物，置身浓密花朵与宝石色光线之间。背景是深色叶片与花枝交错的密林，茎叶之间有细小暖色光点发亮。面孔以四分之三侧面占据左侧与中央，向右下方一簇粉色花朵低垂。闭合眼睑与微微张开的嘴唇赋予神情安静沉浸的感觉。繁茂头饰以浅色花朵、青绿色珠粒、反光亮片和细小紫色重音覆盖发际与额头上缘。松散花朵和卷曲叶片继续环绕左耳并穿过上边缘，使人物融入周围花园。一只手停在右侧花朵旁，弯曲手指靠近一朵大的玫瑰色花。左下方肩膀与上胸部还覆盖层叠衣料与闪亮装饰，小面积粉、金和蓝色反光停在其表面。冷青光落在额头、鼻子与脸颊，暖琥珀和珊瑚光则从左侧及后方升起。相对的灯光将面部划分成鲜活色面，却不压平自然轮廓。近景花瓣柔软丰厚，部分叠在手和肩前；较暗叶片之间出现细小闪点。贴近裁切让花丛围合之外没有可见地平线或环境。影像有浅景深与光亮、可触的表面，清楚五官和少数亮片衬在柔化的枝叶前。整体构图繁盛而亲密，以冷色面部光对照暖色花朵和深色负空间，创造梦境般舞台气氛。
style_prompt_en: The staged photographic treatment surrounds a focused, softly modeled central form with abundant layered texture. Saturated cyan and teal light meet coral, rose, amber, and violet accents; these opposed colors describe volume rather than merely decorating it. Glossy beads and tiny points of light punctuate matte soft surfaces and deep leafy shadows. Selected features remain sharp, while near and far details bloom into shallow-focus softness, creating depth inside a tightly packed frame. Organic curves overlap densely, but dark pockets between them preserve separation and give the eye places to rest. Lighting is theatrical and multidirectional, with cool illumination on one side and warm glow from another. The overall effect is sumptuous and dreamlike, held together by deliberate focal sharpness and controlled color contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 这种布景摄影处理以繁多层叠肌理包围一个清晰、柔和塑形的中央体块。饱和青蓝与青绿光遇上珊瑚、玫瑰、琥珀和紫色重音；相对颜色塑造体积，而不只是装饰它。光亮珠粒和细小光点穿插在哑光柔软表面与深色枝叶阴影之间。选定细节保持清晰，近处与远处局部则在浅景深中柔化发散，于紧密画幅内建立纵深。有机曲线密集叠压，但彼此间的暗色空隙维持分离，也给视线落脚处。光线富舞台感且来自多方向，一侧受冷光照亮，另一侧泛出暖光。整体效果丰盛而梦幻，由有意选择的焦点清晰度和受控的色彩对照维系。
theme_en: A flower-crowned figure in a jewel-lit garden close-up
theme_zh: 宝石色灯光下花冠人物的花园特写
name: James Bidgood
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
